description: During the Q4 rock walkthrough, David corrected two facts Quinn's Q3 post-mortem and Q4 proposal got wrong because they lived outside IES-visible sources: (1) The joint-play portfolio already exists: 10 named plays are in a dashboard in Artifacts, not 'zero joint plays all quarter / portfolio live by Oct 17'. Quinn's evidence sweep (memory/, reviews/, projects/, episodic/) had no path to the Artifacts dashboard. (2) The Forgiveness Letter has been written and is done, not 'still open, deferred a fourth consecutive quarter' — it was completed outside the system with no knowledge-layer record.
correction: The play portfolio exists (10 plays, Artifacts dashboard) and the Forgiveness Letter is complete. Rock 1's portfolio-creation key result is obsolete; the letter comes off the carried-items list. Also per David: thought leadership continues with the podcast and a significant amount of speaking (stays an active workstream, not a sustain line).
systemic_fix: Proposed for rock-review workflow: add an explicit 'state outside the system' prompt step — before declaring a workstream dead or unstarted, ask David directly whether work exists outside IES-visible sources (Artifacts dashboards, external docs, out-of-band work). Absence of evidence inside the system is not evidence of absence, especially for executive work done in other tools.
